description: This file is a JSON schema defining the interface for the HdcpProfile plugin of a software project. It specifies data structures, methods, events, and the overall API for HDCP-related functionalities.

methods.name: getHDCPStatus
methods.description: Returns HDCP-related data, including connection status, compliance, protocol versions, and reason codes.

methods.name: getSettopHDCPSupport
methods.description: Returns the HDCP support details of the set-top box, including supported version and support status.
